moonwell_gloomcap_sacs.accept_text: Moonwell Hollow. The way down is at the Moonwell itself, north of Astranaar past the lake. Off the sporelings. Unbroken.

moonwell_blighted_roots.accept_text: Off the Twilight Rootbinders in Moonwell Hollow, under the Moonwell, north of Astranaar.

moonwell_hollow_cull.accept_text: Down into Moonwell Hollow. The Moonwell is north of Astranaar, past the lake, and the Hollow opens beneath it.

moonwell_mosshide.accept_text: At the heart of the spread, deep in Moonwell Hollow, north of Astranaar.

moonwell_maelwyn.accept_text: At the well at the very bottom of Moonwell Hollow. You know the way down by now - the Moonwell, north of Astranaar.

barrows_hunters_horns.accept_text: Off the huntsmen in the Howling Barrows. The barrow mouth is in the far north-east corner of the forest.

barrows_wintermaw.accept_text: The Houndkeepers' Crypt, in the Howling Barrows, north-east of Splintertree at the corner of the forest.

barrows_hunt_king.accept_text: At the deepest end of the Howling Barrows, north-east of Splintertree.

groms_felguard_overseer.accept_text: Grom's Rest, east of Splintertree, in the Demon Wastes. The Bone Hall is the last gate before the Inner Sanctum.

groms_void_handmaiden.turn_in_text:
I feel lighter.

I think it is lighter. I've been standing in the same tent for a month and something has changed in it and I cannot tell you what.

barrows_rimebone_cull.accept_text: In the Howling Barrows, along the Hunt-King's road - the rimebone dead, the wights and the howling wraiths.

groms_garrison_cull.accept_text: The hall beyond the gate at Grom's Rest. Dread imps and corrupted felhounds, until it is quiet. Dread imps and corrupted felhounds, until it is quiet.
